# Welcome to jk-dot-com 👋

This is the home of the **jk-dot-com** organization on GitHub. We build thoughtfully crafted digital experiences and tools.

## 🎯 What We're About

We focus on creating elegant solutions across web, design systems, and developer tools. Our projects emphasize quality, accessibility, and user experience.

## 📦 Our Projects

### Core Products
- **[jk.com](https://github.com/jk-dot-com/jk.com)** — A modern portfolio and profile site
- **[jk.com Design System](https://github.com/jk-dot-com/jk.com-design-system)** — Reusable components and design tokens powering our products

### Infrastructure
- **[.github](https://github.com/jk-dot-com/.github)** — Organization-wide configurations and shared workflows

## 🔧 Tech Stack

We work with modern web technologies including:
- React & Next.js for web development
- TypeScript for type-safe code
- Tailwind CSS for styling
- Node.js for backend services

## 🤝 Contributing

We welcome contributions from the community! Whether it's bug reports, feature requests, or pull requests, please feel free to get involved.

### Getting Started
1. Fork a repository that interests you
2. Create a feature branch (`git checkout -b feature/amazing-feature`)
3. Commit your changes (`git commit -m 'Add amazing feature'`)
4. Push to the branch (`git push origin feature/amazing-feature`)
5. Open a Pull Request
